title: ByteMark: A Unified Byte-Level Watermark for Detection Across Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.14427v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As watermarking of LLM-generated text enters deployment, users increasingly need to check text whose source is unknown. Existing detectors read the watermark through a specific tokenizer or embedding pipeline, and even if all providers adopted the same watermarking method, differences in these representations would leave their watermarks incompatible, and the text alone does not reveal which representation produced it. We propose ByteMark, a unified watermarking scheme that defines its signal on the UTF-8 bytes of published text. Models with different tokenizers embed this signal under one public specification and key, and a single detector verifies the text from the text and key alone. translated_title: ByteMark：一种跨语言模型检测的统一字节级水印
translated_abstract: 随着针对大语言模型（LLM）生成文本的水印技术进入部署阶段，用户越来越需要检测来源未知的文本。现有的检测器需要通过特定的分词器或嵌入流水线来读取水印，即使所有提供商都采用相同的水印方法，这些表示形式上的差异也会导致各自的水印互不兼容，而且文本本身无法揭示它是由哪种表示形式生成的。我们提出了ByteMark，一种统一的水印方案，它在已发布文本的UTF-8字节上定义水印信号。使用不同分词器的模型可以在一个公开的规范和密钥下嵌入此信号，而单个检测器仅凭文本和密钥即可完成验证。当基线检测器所依赖的分词器或嵌入模型被替换时，其检测性能会急剧下降；而ByteMark既不依赖分词器也不依赖嵌入模型，因此能够保持其检测率。此外，即使参与模型继续生成或重写相关文本，ByteMark仍然可以被检测到。
tldr: ByteMark提出了一种基于UTF-8字节的统一水印方案，使不同分词器的语言模型生成的水印可被单一检测器识别，解决了现有水印检测依赖特定分词器或嵌入模型所导致的兼容性问题。
en_tdlr: ByteMark proposes a unified watermarking scheme defined on UTF-8 bytes, enabling a single detector to verify watermarks from language models with different tokenizers, addressing the incompatibility issues of existing detectors that depend on specific tokenizers or embedding pipelines.
